name: Wagamama Oppai Paradise
original_name: わがままおっぱいパラダイス
source:
Hiroki invites his senior and girlfriend, Yuuna, over to his house for the first time. The atmosphere is good when they're alone, and just when they're about to have sex for the first time, his younger sister Nanaka bursts into the room. Frustrated that she lost her brother, Nanaka challenges Yuuna to a breast contest. While acknowledging the appeal of both, Hiroki chooses Yuuna, and Nanaka admitted defeat on the spot,, but the next day she crawls into Hiroki's futon...!!

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=753073]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
广树第一次邀请他的前辈兼女友优奈到家里做客。两人独处时气氛正好，就在他们即将发生第一次关系时，妹妹菜花冲进了房间。因为失去了哥哥而感到沮丧的菜花向优奈发起了胸部对决。广树在承认两者各有魅力之后选择了优奈，菜花当场认输，但第二天她就钻进了广树的被子里……！！
